title: Comptime Reflection
description: Write a Zig program that uses comptime reflection to print information about a struct's fields at compile time.
verificationTest: output.includes('id: u32') && output.includes('name: []const u8') && output.includes('age: u8')
hints: `inline for` unrolls the loop at compile time, allowing access to comptime field metadata
`field.field_type` gives the type, convert to string with `@typeName()`
